The '''[[speeder bike]]s''' of the [[Kintan Striders Gang]] were overpowered [[repulsorcraft]] that were as dangerous as the [[Nikto]]s often found riding them. With many of the comforts and safety features of civilian models stripped away, the speeders were crafted for maximum speed and marked by the [[Bone|skeletal]] gang symbol.<ref name="Databank" />
